output.summary: KEP-2558 proposed publishing field-level versioning (prerelease status, minimum Kubernetes version, and feature gate) for built-in API fields in OpenAPI via a vendor extension derived from comment tags. The KEP was withdrawn; its status is withdrawn at alpha stage.
output.rationale: The problem was that feature gate comments in kube_features.go are not parseable and new fields lack a mapping to the feature gate that controls them, so alpha fields are hard to identify. The KEP proposed a +lifecycle comment tag on fields, emitted as an x-kubernetes-version OpenAPI extension, with a linter checking feature gate names. Withdrawal came later: in 2024 Thockin noted the project had settled on +featureGate tags, which was the original goal, and jpbetz agreed the KEP should be withdrawn without a champion.
output.outcome_reason: Withdrawn on 2024-10-31 via PR #4937. Thockin said "We have a de-facto norm of +featureGate now, which was the original goal", and jpbetz approved the withdrawal saying "without a champion, I agree that marking the KEP this way is appropriate."

alternatives.option: Extend prerelease-lifecycle-gen to record field-level metadata
alternatives.why_not: The KEP says that generator only covers packages, and that field-level data would not be surfaced in OpenAPI, which makes it harder for other tools to consume.
The KEP says this would limit the metadata to openapi-gen, and reviewers preferred separate, simpler marker lines.

alternatives.option: Allow multiple prerelease statuses per field in comment tags
alternatives.why_not: The KEP says this risks greatly increasing OpenAPI schema size, with CRDs that embed several PodTemplateSpecs able to exceed the 1MB etcd limit.

alternatives.option: Add comment tags to all non-GA types and list GA types as exceptions
alternatives.why_not: The KEP lists this as an alternative that may be considered in the future, after feedback on the field-level proposal.

I see https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/103022 was closed for inactivity. I just want some common form across API comments - did we get too ambitious?
This KEP proposes changes to the kube-openapi generator to add a new vendor extension field `x-kubernetes-api-lifecycle` in OpenAPI.
